title: Build Grave Accord with 63 bosses, 21 class transformations and distinct difficulties
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord runs 63 distinct boss identities with individual original themes across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons and six maps. This is unfinished feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft and main protected.

This checkpoint adds 21 actual ability transformations, three per class, at the existing utility paths' depth-three nodes (six cumulative SP). Costs, IDs, prerequisites, numeric bonuses and the single-capstone rule remain. Soldier gains staggered locked shots/midpoint supply/moving rally; Heavy a finite front wall/vent rings/split cones; Tank departure cover/moving once-per-entrant protection/angled panels; Medic chained cleansing/delayed healing/mobile triage; Mage delayed ward/orbit pulses/twin sigils; Engineer absorbed-damage reflection/mobile siege/paired turrets; Assassin delayed sweep/departure traps/a finite aim-attracting decoy. Each transformation has a concrete tradeoff. Shared authority owns collision, damage/healing credit, timing and cleanup. Both skill views display names and behavioral help in all fifteen locales.

All latest human difficulty requests are retained: Normal revival 25%, Easy 50%, Baby 100%, Hard+ disabled across every combat route; phase shield events only Baby/Easy Standard, six/three circles with two/three-second channels; every Brutal form removes the event. Baby has two extra cover props per map; Hard retains half cover and Insane/Hellish none. Hellish adds warned lava and forces every encounter Brutal. Threats 1-2 use two half-health phases with segmented health and separate transition cues, while Brutal adds warned repeats and authored mechanics under the unchanged 4,000-hostile cap. Normal health remains unchanged.

Early Watch integrates Ashen Usher 1--, Brass Toad 1- and Ragpicker's Kite 1 with 36 selected motion poses, three original scores, distinct phases/movement/arena pressure, warned counterplay and fifteen-locale help. Total selected motion poses are 1,502. Fixed grades use -- / - / no sign / + / ++, with B separate and secrets >10. The optional Expanded skill map exposes all 54 skills/class with bounded zoom, scrolling and keyboard navigation; classic stays the default.

Protocol 18 carries known issued protocol-17 local saves/profiles forward, preserving purchases, run identity and progression; existing bounded migrations remain and online state stays strict. The decoy never enters the real roster or progression scaling. Delayed work cancels for inactive/disconnected owners; reflection is capped and repeated aura entry cannot refill a finite shield. Existing profiles/cosmetics, five modes, all seven kits and bank-safe secret consent work.

Validation: 457 automated tests plus authored content, fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass. The 32 new focused checks legally buy and exercise every ability transformation, actual emission timing/damage/healing/collision/targeting/prediction, capstone interactions, revival restrictions, cleanup and bounds. Actual owner/observer clients replicate purchased upgrades for every class; both actual shop adapters show localized help with guarded purchases. Exact source/artifact hashes and failed attempts are retained under reviews/class-talents-2026-10-25/. The analytical weapon feasibility model is refreshed for the current revision and explicitly excludes ability benefits.

Seven requested class-upgrade implementation passes and the optional skill-map implementation are complete, with human acceptance open. The roster remains 62 ordinary plus one secret; 88 more ordinary identities and 59 original-boss quality passes remain. Special-ability/boss art, rendered animation, human balance/listening, native-language, physical-device, active mixed-progression multiplayer/WAN/full endurance, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release gates remain open. Simultaneous boss pairs remain future encounter work.

The canonical Wiki has 18 pages and 29 images, published and hash-verified separately from source pushes. Every frozen preview is preserved. The protocol-4 public Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows development archive remain separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
